sources.title: Varuna: Integrating AI with Environmental Data for Water Quality ...
sources.snippet: To address this problem, we tested the hypothesis that an AI system trained on environmental data can accurately predict water quality conditions. Publicly available water quality sample data for Austin, Texas, was combined with environmental data from an API (Application Programming Interface) over an overlapping three-month period.

sources.snippet: 🧠 3. Multi-Signal AI & Hydrological Risk Engine Raw data streams are normalized into an inference vector passed through a hybrid hydrological physics model combined with an XGBoost (Extreme Gradient Boosting) risk scoring classifier.
